answer_text:
To find the equivalent 24-hour water rate, first calculate the rate in barrels per hour:

$$
\text{Rate} = \frac{960 \text{ bbl}}{18 \text{ hours}} = 53.\overline{3} \text{ bbl/hr}
$$

Now convert to barrels per day:

$$
53.\overline{3} \text{ bbl/hr} \times 24 \text{ hr/day} = 1280 \text{ bbl/day}
$$

**Answer: 1280 bbl/day**
